as_told.title: Square structure on Mars photo shared by Chris Ramsey

plain: In 2001 the Mars Global Surveyor, a NASA spacecraft that orbited Mars, took a photo of a square structure on the planet that looks man-made, and the picture has only now gone mainstream. Michels tells this himself on two episodes. He says his friend Chris Ramsay, who makes UFO videos, posted the photo, the podcaster Joe Rogan reshared it, and it has been "verified at the highest levels", a claim that would point to something artificial on Mars.
